# ona_security_policy (Resource)

Manages a security policy: the port and executable guardrails applied to environments the policy is assigned to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_security_policy" "restricted" {
  name = "restricted"

  ports = {
    max_admission_level = "ADMISSION_LEVEL_ORGANIZATION"
  }

  executables = {
    rules = [
      {
        path   = "/usr/bin/curl"
        effect = "EFFECT_AUDIT"
      },
      {
        path   = "npx"
        effect = "EFFECT_BLOCK"
      },
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Security policy name.

### Optional

- `executables` (Attributes) Executable guardrails. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--executables))
- `ports` (Attributes) Port guardrails. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the policy was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Security policy ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID the policy belongs to. Resolved from the authenticated identity.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the policy was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--executables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `executables`

Optional:

- `rules` (Attributes Set) Per-executable decisions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--executables--rules))

Read-Only:

- `default_effect` (String) Effect applied to executables that match no rule. Always `EFFECT_ALLOW`.

<a id="nestedatt--executables--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `executables.rules`

Required:

- `effect` (String) Decision for this executable: `EFFECT_AUDIT` or `EFFECT_BLOCK`. `EFFECT_ALLOW` is not accepted on a rule.
- `path` (String) Absolute executable path such as `/usr/bin/curl`, or a bare executable name such as `npx`.



<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Optional:

- `max_admission_level` (String) Caps how widely a user may share a port: `ADMISSION_LEVEL_OWNER_ONLY`, `ADMISSION_LEVEL_CREATOR_ONLY`, `ADMISSION_LEVEL_ORGANIZATION` or `ADMISSION_LEVEL_EVERYONE`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_security_policy.restricted <security-policy-id>
```
